item.description:
What's new

  • Faster search. Searching now loads only what the results list needs instead of downloading every matching conversation in full, so results appear much sooner.

Notes

  • Search results no longer show the attachment name under a conversation until you open it. Attachments themselves are unchanged.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed a bug where starting a new email by clicking someone's address in a conversation opened a window you couldn't send from — the Send button did nothing.

What's new

  • Undo Send is now in the reading pane. A message you've just sent appears at the top of the conversation with a countdown and an Undo Send button, so you don't have to spot the notice in the sidebar.
  • Faster launch. Normal Mail opens straight into your mail instead of pausing on startup checks, and it no longer locks you out when your connection drops.
  • Faster scrolling and reading. Message lists and conversations do far less repeated work, which shows up most on long threads and large mailboxes.

Bug fixes

  • Attached images no longer go missing. Some senders tag every image in a way that made Normal Mail treat it as part of the message body and hide it — those now appear as attachments, and forward correctly too.
  • Replying to a conversation you found through search now updates both the conversation and the message list right away, instead of looking like nothing happened.
  • Changing the From account on a reply no longer fails silently. The reply is sent as a new conversation from that account.
  • Opening a new message from a notification now works while a search is active — the search clears and the message opens, instead of emptying the reading pane.
  • If a message fails to send and notifications are turned off, Normal Mail now tells you instead of failing quietly.
  • Reading a conversation is no longer interrupted every time mail is checked — expanded messages stay expanded and your place is kept.
